script_text: Virgo, your earth sign gets a Mercury-led twist: money can appear, then vanish. Tuesday into Wednesday, Mercury in your 11th House squares Neptune in your 8th House, so verify invoices with receipts; Tuesday is hardest because Mars conjuncts Saturn in Aries, your 8th House, stirring debt pressure. Thursday shifts when Venus in your 11th House meets Jupiter entering Cancer, turning one friend into a love and money lead. Gemini New Moon builds in your 10th House, spotlighting reputation and career. Friday to Sunday, Sun trines Pluto in your 6th House, so work becomes precise. The weekend favors team plans and a manager notices. Friday is your best day because Venus-Jupiter in the 11th boosts romance, networking, and income. Tuesday is your worst day because Mars-Saturn in the 8th strains shared finances. As Mercury rules you, schedule the hard talk for Friday. Follow for daily updates.
